title: Assert the exact telemetry URN in telemetry tests

values: telemetry test: `// Telemetry:` header present, telemetry: URN segment in path, or colocated with telemetry emitter
facts.note: Classifying a test as a telemetry test (header / URN segment / colocation) and extracting claimed URNs requires the bun_telemetry_test validator. Applies regardless of task wording.
Rule is inert until the repository adopts the telemetry rule family; adoption state must be observed.
NON-GATING discovery hint only; covered telemetry tests activate the rule independently of task wording (e.g. a task that only renames an item).

fires: A test file with a `// Telemetry: telemetry:event:...` header whose code only asserts the emitter was called with any argument.
A telemetry test whose header URN appears only in the header or another comment, not in an assertion string in code.
A telemetry test whose header URN appears only as an unused string literal (e.g. a constant never used in any assertion).
A telemetry test identified only by URN segment or colocation that asserts no concrete telemetry: URN.
A telemetry test asserting a URN prefix or a captured-anything matcher instead of the full URN.
A task that renames a telemetry item or edits a test's `// Telemetry:` header without touching assertions, leaving header and asserted URNs out of sync.
doesNotFire: A non-telemetry test file (no Telemetry header, no URN segment, not colocated with telemetry).
A repository that has not adopted the telemetry rule family (rule inert).
A telemetry test whose assertions contain every header URN verbatim as a string literal (whether passed directly or nested in an asserted value).
Once generated contracts ship, a test asserting the generated contract identifier for the item.

given: A Bun test is a telemetry test: it claims URNs in `// Telemetry:` headers, or is identified by URN segment or colocation.
when: Writing, changing or checking that test, including edits to its header or to a claimed item's identity.
then: Every URN claimed in the test's `// Telemetry:` header appears verbatim in the test's code as an assertion string (a string literal that takes part in an assertion, not an unused literal); a headerless telemetry test asserts at least one concrete telemetry: URN. Once generated contracts ship, the item's contract identifier satisfies this the same way.
prefer: Name the item in the assertion itself: expect(emit).toHaveBeenCalledWith("telemetry:event:be:example:item-accepted", { item_id: "i-1" });
avoid: Asserting the mocked emitter was called with anything.
Asserting a URN prefix or a captured-anything matcher.
Relying on the URN in the header or any comment — comments do not assert.
A quoted URN present in code but never used in an assertion.
unless: The repository has not adopted this rule family — inert until adoption, like every rule in the family.
why: An any-call assertion proves emission, not that the planned item fired; renames and copy-paste drift hide there. Exact URNs keep assertion and plan from silently diverging.
evidence: For each URN in the test's `// Telemetry:` headers, the same URN occurs verbatim as a quoted string in the comment-masked test source, and that string takes part in an assertion (not an unused literal).
For a telemetry test with no header (identified by URN segment or colocation), at least one concrete telemetry: URN string is asserted in comment-masked code.
bun_telemetry_test validator reports no finding for this rule; a reviewer confirms the matching strings are used in assertions.
verifier_detail: Claimed URNs = URNs listed in the test's `// Telemetry:` header(s).
Mask comments before searching; header/comment occurrences never satisfy the rule.
Match must be the concrete URN verbatim inside a string literal (exact_identity): not a prefix, not a captured-anything matcher, not a comment.

Mechanical check: claimed URN found as a quoted string in comment-masked source. The obligation is that this string is an assertion string (used in an assertion, directly or nested in an asserted value); literal presence is the detector's approximation.
Telemetry tests identified only by URN segment or colocation must assert at least one concrete `telemetry:` URN string in code.
When generated contracts ship, a contract identifier for the item satisfies the check the same way as the URN literal (equally acceptable, not preferred).
Rule is inert until the repository adopts the telemetry family.
Implementation: validator bun_telemetry_test. Severity 3, disposition strict.
Applicability is determined by the test file's classification (header / URN segment / colocation), never by task wording.
audit: Original name: Telemetry tests assert the exact item identity

Original statement (S006): Every concrete telemetry URN a telemetry test claims in its `// Telemetry:` header appears in the test's code as an assertion string; a telemetry test with no header asserts at least one concrete telemetry URN (REQUIRED).
Inert until adoption is a family-wide property of the Bun telemetry rules.

Original fix_hint example (S020): expect(emit).toHaveBeenCalledWith("telemetry:event:be:commons:response-invocation-accepted", { response_id: "r-1" }); — generalized in prefer[0] to a neutral URN/payload with the same exact-string assertion pattern.

sharedNodes.text: disposition: strict — atdd-bun fails on every finding; it has no advisory mode and no ratchet baseline.

additions.justification: Restates the source's universal statement (S006: every telemetry test) as an event; no restriction added.
